contract.ownership: Explicit root-owned GroupLocks; selected/default mask query and clearing own stopped labels only
contract.perches: Configured group/index capacity, detached six joint values and nonnegative tolerances, supplied units and root group selection
contract.reset: Explicit once-consumed completion plan, budgeted waits, acknowledgement TRUE even on scripted failure, optional explicit OPOUT[3] result and no artificial pause event
contract.background: Configured slots to same-context cooperative tasks on TaskScheduler; start/resume/pause, policy checks, retained renamed identities and no revival of terminal tasks
contract.ports: Explicit BOOLEAN OPIN/OPOUT/TPIN/TPOUT, addresses 0..maximum; existing kinds remain one-based
contract.persistence: Only data, remaining plans, slot names, finite counters and bounded request history; reject pending reset/live background frames

boundaries: No physical motion, native controller reset, per-value joint group/unit conversion or native perch behavior
MIXBG_STOP uses cooperative suspension; no TP background scan engine or implicit program loading
No panel value acquisition, native channel privileges, executable-link restoration or strict/controller equivalence
